summary: Backend testing for File & Media storage integration on Euphoria Hackathon. Created /app/backend/tests/test_uploads.py with 17 pytest cases covering: public id-proof upload (PNG/PDF success, 5MB+ reject, .exe reject), hackathon logo branding (auth-required + reflected in GET /api/hackathon logoUrl + served via /api/media), club logo & rename (auth-required, reflected in /api/clubs, 404 for unknown slug), media/admin files (404 MEDIA_NOT_FOUND, 403 MEDIA_FORBIDDEN for PDFs, admin bytes download with auth), and registration id_proof enforcement (TEAM_LEAD_ID_PROOF_REQUIRED + successful registration with idProof persisted and visible in admin registration detail). All 17 tests PASSED (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: storage.py: put_object/get_object are sync `requests` calls inside async FastAPI handlers — will block the event loop under load. Consider running them via `await asyncio.to_thread(...)` or switching to httpx.AsyncClient.

uploads.py: file bytes are read fully into memory before size validation (`await file.read()` then `validate_upload(len(data))`). A malicious 500MB upload will still be buffered before rejection. Consider streaming/size guard via Content-Length header or chunked reads with early cutoff.
storage.py MIME_TYPES contains 'svg' -> 'image/svg+xml' and ALLOWED_IMAGE_EXTS includes 'svg'. SVGs can carry XSS payloads; either sanitize or restrict logo uploads to raster formats.
admin.py /branding/club/{slug} silently truncates name to 160 chars without returning a warning — acceptable but consider 422 on overflow for clarity.

public.py _logo_url returns a relative path `/api/media/...` — if backend is served under a different origin than the ingress prefix expects it works, but consider using REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or absolute URL for portability.
No cleanup of orphaned uploaded id-proofs when the registration fails or is never submitted — expected trade-off, but consider a scheduled cleanup job for storage hygiene.
seed_data_creation: Tests upload a real 1x1 PNG and tiny PDF into Emergent Object Storage (paths under euphoria-hackathon/id-proofs/, /hackathon-logo/, /club-logos/gdg-kare/). Test also creates a registration referencing one of the uploaded PNGs. gdg-kare club name is temporarily renamed and best-effort restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new upload/branding/media/id-proof endpoints pass end-to-end against real Emergent Object Storage. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_uploads.py (17 tests). Existing /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers base registration/admin (previously 100%). Endpoints validate: UPLOAD_FAILED on oversize/bad-ext, MEDIA_FORBIDDEN on non-image via /api/media, MEDIA_NOT_FOUND on missing, CLUB_NOT_FOUND on unknown slug, TEAM_LEAD_ID_PROOF_REQUIRED when member_number==1 has no id_proof. Admin registration detail exposes idProofPath/Filename/ContentType only for team lead.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found during this iteration.
